description:
Ask up to 25 questions of AI answer engines now and measure the brand's and each competitor's share: URL cited among the sources, and brand named. Saved as a citation audit.

Billing: 5–12¢ per engine check, per answered prompt × engine (a repeat within an hour is cached but billed) — Perplexity 5¢, ChatGPT 7¢, AI Overviews 9¢, Gemini 12¢ (33¢ a prompt on the four defaults), AI Mode 10¢ if asked. Then the fix-it playbook get_fix_plan plans from (playbook: false skips it): at most 12¢ per answered check that didn't cite the brand, plus about 45¢ for a rollup when 2+ questions were lost. E.g. 10 prompts, default engines: 330¢ + about 525¢ playbook if nothing cites the brand. dry_run: true quotes it free. Engines get ~4 min; unfinished checks are skipped unbilled (partial, timed_out): split runs past ~15 prompts.

When to call: share of voice across many buyer questions, fresh. One question: check_brand_citation; an audit that already ran: get_audit (free).

Returns { audit_id, report_url (public), tracked: [{domain, is_brand, cite_count, share_pct, mention_count, mention_share_pct}], total_cites, total_mentions, sample: {answered_checks, prompts, confidence, note}, suggested_competitor_domains, suggested_sources, completed, total, partial, timed_out, out_of_credits, charged_cents, charged_breakdown_cents }. Relay sample.note (confidence low = few answers). suggested_competitor_domains: untracked hosts winning lost answers (confirm before add_site); suggested_sources: places to earn mentions. Past ~45 s: { audit_id, status: "running" }; read it with get_audit.

brand.description: Brand as written in prose (e.g. "Linear"). Default: the workspace site's brand.

competitor_domains.description: Up to 20 competitor domains to count. Empty or omitted: the workspace site's own list.

domain.description: The brand's primary domain (e.g. "linear.app"); matched against cited sources, not fetched. Or pass site_id.

dry_run.description: true: return the price quote (estimated_cents, max_cents, breakdown) and what would run. Nothing runs or bills.

engines.description: Engines to ask. Default: the four core engines; add "ai-mode" for Google AI Mode (10¢/check).

playbook.description: Default true: write the fix-it playbook for checks that don't cite the brand (at most 12¢ each; get_fix_plan plans from it). false: checks only.

prompts.description: 1–25 buyer questions; each is 33¢ of checks on the default engines, plus the playbook.

site_id.description: A workspace site (list_sites) instead of domain; fills domain, brand and competitor_domains.

name: get_share_of_voice
title: Compute share of voice vs competitors
